plans.idea: Left-aligned column on one strong left edge: the Solstice lockup sits top-left as a masthead, then a big full-width headline with its subline in the middle, and the Shop Now pill directly beneath on the same left axis, with even vertical rhythm.
Centered poster stack that reads top to bottom: a large centered brand lockup up top, a wide headline and subline block in the middle, and the CTA centered below, all on one vertical axis.

Message first, brand sign-off last: a dominant headline and subline open at the top-left, the CTA sits right under the copy as one action group, and the Solstice lockup anchors the bottom-left corner like a signature.
